Brown Bear (CV 18)

A broad-shouldered forest bear with shaggy brown fur, curved claws and a powerful muzzle. Its bulk conceals surprising speed; food, cubs and personal space matter far more than territory on a map.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

HP: 22 · Speed: 6; climb 4 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 1

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Forepaw slam

It gathers itself, then arrives in a rush of claws and weight.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: After an approach of 2 squares, target is Prone. Standard defense: After an approach of 2 squares, target is Prone.

Crushing bite

Its jaws close on the opening left by a raised shield.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Fortitude. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Bleeding 1.

Shelter the Young

It turns at the cry beside it, bringing its whole body between the danger and the one it protects.

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to a willing ally within 3 squares, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. This movement grants no attack or automatic protection; its body obstructs only the squares it actually occupies. Movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Split logs, shredded bark and fresh berry scat.

Purpose: Protect food and cubs, not win a duel.

Tactics and retreat: Pounce after a short rush, then stand over the place it is defending.

Counterplay and conversation: Leave its food alone and give it space; fire is a threat, not an automatic fear effect.

Habitat: Wilderness · Communication: None

Loot: Food caches and an abandoned hunter’s trap.

Summoning: Animal 3 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.af82525dca612a4c.JournalEntryPage.bd4ae5b085040492]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-brown-bear

Category: Animal · Role: Brute · CV: 18

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 3/5/7

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.3

Action review (#1279): U 1.2 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0
